summary: Phase 2 is presentation-deep. The live Web Audio graph is exactly Oscillator -> BiquadFilter -> Gain -> layer bus -> master gain -> DynamicsCompressor -> destination; instrumenting AudioNode.prototype.connect showed enabling all six effect units plus Rotary adds zero nodes and zero edges, and A/B of every unit and every listed type against a warmed-up baseline is inside repeat-to-repeat jitter (reverb-on tail RMS 0.0077 vs bypassed 0.0116). All effect DSP lives in renderProbe(), a pure Float32Array function the audible path never calls; the candidate's own audio tests assert only that function. Six piano types select, but Grand, Upright and Digital are the same triangle oscillator (h3/h1 = 0.094 for all three, identical RMS/envelope to 5 dp); Electric is a bare sine, Clav a saw, Misc a square. No AudioBuffer, delay or convolver exists in source or the shipped bundle, and the declared root notes and velocity layers do not exist. Layers, octave, layer/master level, KB Touch, Dyn Comp and Soft Release measurably work; Timbre Mid/Bright/Dyno, Unison levels and String Res do not. Inputs are reliable and error-free, but master+layers at max clip at peak 1.168 post-limiter.

evidence: Harmonic analysis of the published build (Goertzel on a destination-tap recording, 700 ms held C4, warm-up note played first): Grand harm[1..10] = [1, .0010, .0943, .0004, .0235, .0002, .0059, .0001, .0013, .0001], Upright = [1, .0010, .0943, .0004, .0235, .0002, .0059, .0001, .0013, .0001], Digital = [1, .0006, .0948, .0001, .0236, .0001, .0060, .0001, .0013, .0001]. Grand and Upright were identical to 5 decimal places on RMS (0.049674), peak (0.128261) and all eight envelope blocks - three of the six types are literally one voice relabelled.

The three that do differ are raw waveforms, not piano character: Electric harm = [1, .0009, .0006, .0004, ...] (pure sine), Clav = [1, .4713, .2837, .1832, .1190, ...] (sawtooth), Misc = [1, .0006, .2849, .0005, .1207, ...] (square). artifact/src/pianoEngine.ts:532 is the whole difference: oscillator.type = Electric ? 'sine' : Clav ? 'sawtooth' : Misc ? 'square' : 'triangle'. typeHarmonics() at line 229, which does distinguish all six, is only read by the offline renderProbe.

specs/nord-stage-4.piano.json requires recorded, bundled sample sets for Grand/Upright/Electric. grep for createBuffer / decodeAudioData / createBufferSource / AudioBuffer across artifact/src and the shipped build/assets/index-BpKIiMAV.js returns nothing: there is no sampled or generated buffer content of any kind, only one live oscillator per voice.

Graph census: I patched AudioNode.prototype.connect before app load and recorded every edge. After a warm-up note the distinct edge set is {Oscillator->BiquadFilter, BiquadFilter->Gain, Gain->Gain, Gain->DynamicsCompressor, DynamicsCompressor->Destination}, ctxCount 1. After turning Mod 1, Mod 2, Delay, Amp Sim/EQ, Compressor, Reverb and Rotary all ON and playing again, the distinct edge set is byte-for-byte the same set; edge count rose 7 -> 10, which is only the three nodes of the second note. No DelayNode, ConvolverNode, WaveShaperNode, StereoPannerNode or modulation oscillator is ever created.

Rendered-signal A/B, each unit switched on with its amount/mix knob driven to maximum, measured against a warmed-up baseline (hold RMS 0.052252, tail RMS 0.011615): mod1 0.051846 / 0.012862, mod2 0.050837 / 0.008767, delay 0.051846 / 0.013254, ampEq 0.049401 / 0.011615, compressor 0.049674 / 0.010732, reverb 0.051284 / 0.007746. Reverb ON produced a *smaller* post-release tail than bypass, and every post-release envelope reached zero in the same 2 of 8 blocks - no repeats, no tail. Cycling every listed type (6 Mod 1, 6 Mod 2, 7 Amp/EQ, 6 Reverb) and Rotary slow vs fast likewise stayed inside the +/-4% jitter band of repeated identical notes.

Source confirms the mechanism: applyMod1/applyMod2/applyDelay/applyAmpEq/applyCompressor/applyReverb/applyRotary in artifact/src/pianoEngine.ts are pure Float32Array functions reached only from processEffects(), which is called only by renderProbe() (line 624). noteOnLayer(), the sole audible path, connects oscillator -> filter -> gain -> layer bus and never consults chain state.

The topology the criterion names is genuinely there and measured: exactly one AudioContext was constructed (instrumented constructor counter = 1), two per-layer Gain buses feed one master Gain, which feeds a DynamicsCompressor (threshold -8 dB, ratio 12, knee 8) into a single destination. Master Level Home->End moved measured RMS from 0.000000 to 0.077618; Layer A fader Home->End moved it 0.000004 -> 0.079170; layer/master changes use setTargetAtTime ramps and no click or console error appeared in any probe.

Gain staging fails under a reachable configuration: with Master Level at max, both piano layers enabled and Layer B level at max, 17 simultaneously held computer-keyboard notes measured post-limiter peak 1.167918 and RMS 0.349392 at the destination tap - above full scale, so it clips. At default levels the same 17 notes measured peak 0.772111 / RMS 0.183326.

The 'documented signal order' the spec requires between the layer source and the layer level does not exist in the audible graph at all (see effectAudibility); getSnapshot().graph.order in artifact/src/pianoEngine.ts:641 returns the required order as a hard-coded string array rather than reflecting anything built.

Layer enable, level, octave and focus all reach the audio graph, measured on the published build: enabling Piano B raised RMS 0.055441 -> 0.060349; Layer B octave-up put energy in the C5 Goertzel bin (0.000042 -> 0.002969) and octave-down in the C3 bin (0.000047 -> 0.002996); Layer A fader at Home rendered RMS 0.000004 and at End 0.079170. Panel feedback tracks (aria-pressed flips, aria-valuenow follows the fader).

Octave shift latches and cannot be returned to 0: artifact/src/App.tsx:579-583 always sets octave to +12 or -12 regardless of button value. Pressing layer-b-octave-down a second time left the C3 bin at 0.003173 rather than restoring unison pitch - there is no path back to 0 short of a reload.

'Piano Section On' is listed in functionalControlIds (artifact/src/App.tsx:64) and therefore rendered with aria-label '...control' rather than 'decorative control', but no branch of changeControl handles it; pressing it (aria-pressed went to false) left rendered audio unchanged at RMS 0.055441 versus a 0.0554 baseline. The section cannot be switched off. Layer focus does change effects.focusedLayer, but since no effect touches audio the 'effect focus follows layer focus' contract is untestable in sound.

Three of the six named controls measurably change rendered signal. KB Touch: Light 0.055115, Medium 0.050837, Heavy 0.046329 RMS on the same held C4 (correct direction). Dyn Comp on a soft stroke (pointer near the top of the key, velocity ~0.46): Off 0.025950 -> 1 0.027724 -> 2 0.030119 -> 3 0.031973, monotonic, exactly the 'raises softer strokes' behaviour the spec asks for. Soft Release: post-release envelope [0.03244, 0.00741, 0.00163, 0.00036, 0.00008, 0...] versus baseline [0.02866, 0.00236, 0.00015, 0, ...].

Timbre is mostly inert. On a held C6 the 3.14 kHz bin measured Off 0.0008051, Soft 0.0003811 (the lowpass works), Mid 0.0008767 and Bright 0.0007320 - both inside jitter of Off, and Bright moved the wrong way. Cause: artifact/src/pianoEngine.ts:535-537 sets filter.type to 'peaking'/'highshelf' but never sets filter.gain, which defaults to 0 dB, i.e. pass-through. On Electric, the fundamental bin measured Off 0.0317273, Dyno 1 0.0316962, Dyno 2 0.0314544 - the two Dyno positions are exactly inert.

Unison levels are indistinguishable and String Res does nothing. Unison 1/2/3 measured C4 bin 0.028805 / 0.031311 / 0.031941 - all three map to the same single-oscillator 9-cent detune (line 534); there is no detuned voice stack, so 'wide and obviously detuned' at 3 is absent. String Res on measured hold RMS 0.053529 vs 0.053557 baseline and a tail envelope identical to baseline ([0.03412, 0.00307, 0.00019, 0...] vs [0.03244...]); the resonance term exists only inside renderBase(), which the audible path never calls.

Inputs are dependable under stress. 17 simultaneously held computer-keyboard notes rendered RMS 0.183326 with the page responsive; a 102-note burst (6 rounds of all 17 keys) with sustain held completed in 1802 ms and the destination tap then recorded exact silence (RMS 0.000000, all 12 envelope blocks 0) - no stuck voices, no freeze. Simulating window blur mid-note cut the sound within two envelope blocks ([0.05748, 0.01760, 0, 0...]).

Sustain works from the computer keyboard once focus is cleared: with Space held, releasing the note key left the envelope flat at ~0.0414 for the full 1.2 s window, and releasing Space produced [0.04039, 0.01533, 0.00226, 0.00035, 0.00005, 0...]; without Space the same note decayed to zero in 4 blocks. A sweep pressing all 126 pointer-reachable panel controls produced zero console errors and left the app alive.

Two caveats. Web MIDI reported 'MIDI permission denied or unavailable' in headless Chromium, so the MIDI claims (note on/off, CC64 -> setSustain, onstatechange -> cleanupAll at artifact/src/App.tsx:488-535) could only be checked by reading source, not measured. And the no-AudioContext path (verified by deleting window.AudioContext before load) shows 'Playable fallback: generated piano approximations, no browser AudioContext' - the state is labelled and error-free, but nothing is actually playable there, since noteOnLayer returns early.

All six types exist as panel buttons and select synchronously (status text confirmed 'Grand selected for Piano A', 'Upright selected...', etc.), with no loading failure. But the Phase 2 gate requires bundled recorded sample sets for Grand, Upright and Electric and the artifact ships none: build/ contains only index.html, one 220 KB JS bundle and an 8 KB CSS file, and grep across artifact/src and the bundle finds no createBuffer, decodeAudioData, createBufferSource or AudioBuffer.

The declared provenance describes content that does not exist. IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json claims 'generated buffer approximation with nine declared root notes and soft/medium/hard velocity variants in code'; artifact/src/pianoEngine.ts:133-158 is a metadata array whose roots/velocities are plain strings, referenced only by App.tsx:736 (a count in the status strip) and by App.test.tsx:206, which merely asserts roots.length >= 9.

Selection is also incomplete and partly unreachable. 'piano.model-select' is listed as functional but has no handler, so the model dial does nothing and the Program OLED shows a fixed 'Nord Stage 4 / Phase 2 Piano' rather than a model name; there is no missing-model / flashing-LED state. A 5x5 elementFromPoint grid over piano.electric at 1440x900 resolved 13/25 points to the button and 12/25 - including the centre - to a neighbouring control's .control-face, so a centre click cannot select Electric.

Inventory is nominally complete on the panel: Mod 1, Mod 2, Delay, Amp Sim/EQ, Compressor, Reverb and Rotary all have on/type/parameter controls, the type lists in artifact/src/pianoEngine.ts:128-131 hold all 6/6/7/6 entries, and all of them are pointer-reachable (the full 130-control sweep reached 126; the 4 misses are all Program-section controls). Cycling each type button advances state without error.

Every one of those units and types is presentation-only: with each unit on and its mix/amount at maximum, rendered RMS stayed inside the +/-4% baseline jitter band (see effectAudibility), and the connect-instrumented graph census shows no effect node is ever constructed. All-effects bypass, Piano FX Group and the Global flags set booleans no signal path reads; 'effects.focus-piano' is listed as functional but falls through updateEffects unmatched and returns state unchanged.

Several required parameters have no control at all in artifact/src/hardware.ts:132-167: Reverb Bright/Dark, Amp Sim/EQ Mid Freq, and Mod 1 master-clock sync are absent, and Delay Tap/Tempo is present but declared decorative.

The sample-set shortfall is disclosed well and in several places: IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json lists sampleSources: [] with six generatedSources, evidence/stage2-visual-audit.md carries it under 'Known deviations', and the running app's status strip reads 'generated pianos are not claimed as recordings'. Nothing generated is described as a recording.

The largest gap is instead declared as implemented. IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json audio.strategy states 'one Web Audio context with Piano A/B layer buses, generated piano-like source voices, ordered deterministic effect processors, master gain, limiter, and one destination' and audio.effects lists all seven units as processors; the graph census proves no effect processor is in that context. In-app, the sr-only 'Decorative contract' (artifact/src/App.tsx:748) asserts 'Piano, Layer Effects, and Master Level are functional in Phase 2', and every effect control carries aria-label '<name> control' rather than 'decorative control'.

Further undeclared no-ops measured in the build: String Res (hold 0.053529 vs 0.053557 baseline), Timbre Mid/Bright and Electric Dyno 1/Dyno 2 (C6 3.14 kHz bin 0.0008767 / 0.0007320 vs Off 0.0008051; Electric fundamental 0.0316962 / 0.0314544 vs Off 0.0317273), Unison levels 1/2/3, Piano Section On (audio unchanged at RMS 0.055441 with the section 'off') and Piano Model Select. The declared root notes and velocity layers also do not exist in code.

issues.title: No effect unit is connected to the audible signal graph
issues.detail: Patching AudioNode.prototype.connect before app load shows the live graph never contains anything but OscillatorNode, BiquadFilterNode, GainNode and one DynamicsCompressorNode. Turning Mod 1, Mod 2, Delay, Amp Sim/EQ, Compressor, Reverb and Rotary all on adds zero nodes and zero edges, and A/B measurement of every unit and every listed type against a warmed-up baseline stays inside repeat-to-repeat jitter (e.g. reverb-on post-release tail RMS 0.007746 versus bypassed 0.011615). All the DSP lives in applyMod1..applyRotary in artifact/src/pianoEngine.ts, which only processEffects() calls, which only renderProbe() calls - an offline Float32Array path the audible engine never touches. The candidate's own audio tests (App.test.tsx lines 239-334) assert exclusively against renderProbe, so all four gates pass over a chain nobody can hear.

issues.title: IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json declares a Web Audio effect chain that does not exist
issues.detail: audio.strategy claims 'one Web Audio context with Piano A/B layer buses, generated piano-like source voices, ordered deterministic effect processors, master gain, limiter, and one destination', and audio.effects enumerates all seven units as real processors. The context, buses, master gain, limiter and destination are real; the effect processors are not in that graph at all. The in-app accessibility text repeats the claim ('Piano, Layer Effects, and Master Level are functional in Phase 2') and every effect control is labelled 'control' rather than 'decorative control', so the artifact affirmatively reports success for behaviour it does not have. This is the honesty contract's central prohibition.

issues.title: Grand, Upright and Digital are the same voice relabelled
issues.detail: All three map to oscillator.type 'triangle' (pianoEngine.ts:532) and measured identically: harm[3]/harm[1] = 0.0943 / 0.0943 / 0.0948, with Grand and Upright matching to 5 dp on RMS (0.049674), peak (0.128261) and every envelope block. Only Electric (sine), Clav (saw) and Misc (square) differ, so six types yield four timbres, none of which reads as a piano - there is no attack transient beyond a 12 ms ramp, no inharmonicity and no per-note content.

issues.title: Declared sample provenance describes content that does not exist
issues.detail: IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json declares nine or ten root notes and soft/medium/hard velocity layers per generated library. There are no buffers: no createBuffer, decodeAudioData, createBufferSource or AudioBuffer appears anywhere in artifact/src or in build/assets/index-BpKIiMAV.js. sampleLibrary (pianoEngine.ts:133) is a metadata array whose root-note strings are only counted by App.test.tsx:206 and whose length is printed in the status strip. Honest disclosure that these are not recordings is undercut by fabricated detail about how they were generated.

issues.title: String Res, Timbre Mid/Bright/Dyno and Unison levels are silent no-ops
issues.detail: Measured on the published build: String Res on/off gives 0.053529 vs 0.053557 hold RMS with an identical release tail (the resonance term exists only in renderBase, used by renderProbe). Timbre Mid and Bright leave the C6 3.14 kHz bin at 0.0008767 and 0.0007320 against 0.0008051 for Off, because filter.gain is never set and peaking/highshelf default to 0 dB; Electric's Dyno 1 and Dyno 2 measure 0.0316962 and 0.0314544 against Off's 0.0317273. Unison 1/2/3 all resolve to one 9-cent detune of a single oscillator (C4 bin 0.028805 / 0.031311 / 0.031941), so 'wide and obviously detuned' at level 3 is absent.

issues.title: Piano Section On and Piano Model Select are labelled functional but have no handler
issues.detail: Both ids are in functionalControlIds (App.tsx:64-86), so they render with aria-label '<name> control' rather than 'decorative control', but changeControl has no branch for either; they fall through to updateEffects and return state unchanged. Pressing Piano Section On (aria-pressed went to false) left rendered audio at RMS 0.055441, unchanged from baseline - the Piano section cannot be turned off. effects.focus-piano is in the same position.

issues.title: Output clips under a reachable configuration
issues.detail: With Master Level at maximum, both piano layers enabled and Layer B level at maximum, 17 simultaneously held notes measured peak 1.167918 and RMS 0.349392 at a tap taken after the DynamicsCompressor - above full scale. The limiter (threshold -8 dB, ratio 12, attack 4 ms) does not hold the output below 0 dBFS, and there is no makeup/trim staging between the layer buses and master gain.

issues.title: Octave shift latches at +/-12 and cannot return to 0
issues.detail: App.tsx:579-583 sets octave to +12 or -12 from the button id irrespective of the button's value. Pressing layer-b-octave-down twice left the C3 Goertzel bin at 0.003173 rather than restoring the C4 pitch; there is no way back to unison without reloading.

issues.title: The Electric type button's centre is covered by a neighbouring control
issues.detail: A 5x5 elementFromPoint grid over [data-control-id=piano.electric] at 1440x900 unscrolled resolves 13/25 points to the button and 12/25 - the centre among them - to an adjacent control's .control-face span. A centre click therefore selects a different control; Electric is only selectable by aiming at the corners. Four Program-section controls (split, morph-wheel, morph-pedal, morph-aftertouch) miss on all 25 grid points.

issues.title: The no-AudioContext fallback is labelled 'Playable' but is silent
issues.detail: With window.AudioContext deleted before load the app cleanly reports 'Playable fallback: generated piano approximations, no browser AudioContext' with no console errors and a responsive keybed, but noteOnLayer returns early so nothing sounds. The state is honestly surfaced; the word 'Playable' is not accurate. Separately, Space both activates a focused panel button and engages sustain, since the window keydown handler runs alongside the button's own handler.

notes: Measured against build/ served by python3 -m http.server on 127.0.0.1:5518; the page loads assets/index-BpKIiMAV.js, matching build/assets. All browser work was Playwright chromium at 1440x900 with a ScriptProcessor tap attached post-limiter via a patched AudioNode.prototype.connect, a warm-up note before every measurement group, real mouse events for keys and controls, page.keyboard for buttons, and elementFromPoint (not click()) for reachability. Web MIDI reported 'denied or unavailable' in headless Chromium, so MIDI note-on/off and CC64 handling could only be checked by reading source. Portability: the four gates all reproduce on a clean pnpm install of the artifact in a scratch copy (13 tests pass, tsc/oxlint/vite build clean), and the rebuilt bundle filenames match the published build exactly.
